name: LaSR (Library-Augmented Symbolic Regression)
org: Cornell University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
one_liner: Interleaves genetic programming and BFGS constant optimization (PySR) with LLM-synthesized abstract concept libraries for equation discovery.

loop.proposes: An LLM abstracts recurring sub-expressions from top equations into reusable symbolic concepts and seeds mutated expression trees.
loop.judged_by: A high-performance symbolic regression engine (PySR) optimizes numerical constants via BFGS and scores MSE accuracy and complexity on scientific datasets.
loop.steers: Tournament selection and Pareto-front complexity filtering retain the fittest symbolic equations and evolve the concept library.

headline_result: Recovered significantly more exact ground-truth physical laws on the Feynman Symbolic Regression Benchmark than standalone PySR or LLM-only baselines.
caveat: Calling an LLM inside evolutionary epochs increases wall-clock runtime compared to pure Julia genetic programming.
beyond_harness_note: The PySR evolutionary + BFGS numerical optimizer runs the population loop and queries the LLM to evolve abstract symbolic building blocks.
generative_model: LLM symbolic concept and mutation generator
algorithmic_authority: PySR genetic programming and BFGS numerical optimizer

sources.title: Symbolic Regression with a Learned Concept Library (arXiv:2409.09359)

verification.notes: Checked against Grayeli et al., arXiv:2409.09359. Title corrected to the printed title (ledger).
